import pandas as pd


def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    emp_hist = inputs["DIM_EMP_HIST"].copy()
    asof_queries = inputs["ASOF_QUERIES"].copy()

    # Coerce date columns to datetime for correct comparison semantics.
    emp_hist["eff_start_date"] = pd.to_datetime(emp_hist["eff_start_date"])
    emp_hist["eff_end_date"] = pd.to_datetime(emp_hist["eff_end_date"])
    asof_queries["as_of_date"] = pd.to_datetime(asof_queries["as_of_date"])

    # Inner join on emp_id (cartesian per matching emp_id), mirroring the SQL join.
    merged = asof_queries.merge(
        emp_hist,
        on="emp_id",
        how="inner",
        suffixes=("", "_hist"),
    )

    # Half-open interval filter: start inclusive, end exclusive (NULL end = open-ended).
    cond = (merged["as_of_date"] >= merged["eff_start_date"]) & (
        merged["eff_end_date"].isna() | (merged["as_of_date"] < merged["eff_end_date"])
    )

    result = merged.loc[cond, ["query_id", "emp_id", "dept", "grade"]].reset_index(
        drop=True
    )

    return {"asof_result": result}
